name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The undead fear life just as the living fear death. It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.

Unfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.

You must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. May luck be with you, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.

Prepare yourself, adventurer, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.
narrative.requestItemsText: A keepsake of remembrance is a rare find, adventurer.
